infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flyer lets you pick photos you choose: a screenshot of your schedule, a syllabus, a flyer to scan, or a photo to post. Nothing else in your library is accessed.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Flyer uses your location while the app is open to sort nearby places by walking time, find people next to you for Flyer Drop, and, only if you turn them on, to share where you are with friends you choose or during a Safe Walk.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Flyer adds your classes and due dates to a separate Flyer calendar when you tap Export.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Flyer adds your classes and due dates to a separate Flyer calendar when you tap Export, and replaces them when you export again.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This lets ads in Flyer be more relevant. Saying no is fine: you'll still see ads, just less relevant ones. Your schedule, location, and friends are never shared with advertisers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flyer uses the camera when you scan a QR code, scan an event flyer or syllabus, or take a photo to post.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Flyer shows last night's sleep and today's steps next to your schedule. It reads them on your phone only and never saves or shares them.
